title: Patient Payment Plan Payment Methods, Autopay and Statement Schedule
content:
For each **Patient Payment Plan** tier the schedule below states whether automatic payment by ACH or card is required, the autopay methods offered, the calendar days after a failed autopay draft before the single retry, the number of retries of a failed draft, and the calendar days before each due date that the plan statement is sent.

| Tier | Autopay required | Autopay methods | Retry after (calendar days) | Retries | Statement sent before due date (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Riverbend Short-Term Payment Plan | No | ACH, card | 3 | 1 | 21 |
| Riverbend Standard Payment Plan | No | ACH, card | 3 | 1 | 21 |
| Riverbend Extended Payment Plan | Yes | ACH, card | 3 | 1 | 21 |
| Riverbend Long-Term Payment Plan | Yes | ACH, card | 3 | 1 | 21 |
| Riverbend Assistance-Linked Payment Plan | No | ACH, card | 3 | 1 | 21 |
| Riverbend Hardship Payment Plan | No | ACH, card | 3 | 1 | 21 |

## Channels and application of payments (all tiers)

- **Channels through which an installment may be paid:** autopay by ACH, autopay by card, card payment on the patient portal, card payment by phone, and mailed check.
- **Payment above the installment:** applied to reduce the remaining term.
- **Order in which an installment is applied to the enrolled encounters:** the encounter with the oldest service start date first.

A hypothetical draft that fails on the 1st of a month is retried once, 3 calendar days later; the tier allows 1 retry.
